change: Reuse full results from provider-owned builder prewarming workers instead of a second speculative execution. Keep source ordering, transaction/environment checks, exact read validation, eligible fee rebasing, ordered replay and normal root construction.
enabled_when: Execution workers enabled, builder prewarming enabled, native experimental builder.parallel disabled. Default threads=0 is unchanged.
bounds: Two prewarming candidates per prewarming thread. Candidate consumption or discard releases capacity; completed work cannot drain the source unboundedly.

validation.evm: 146 passed, 2 ignored; existing generated differential helper also executes parent-state prewarming and compares complete outcomes, receipts and state roots.
validation.builder: 29 passed, including ordering, completed-result bound and full-buffer shutdown.
validation.aa_node: 2 passed (sequential and parallel), 64 signed expiring-nonce transfers; parallel case explicitly asserts successful prewarming reuse.
validation.observer_node: 2 passed (sequential and parallel); canonical Engine execution with worker activity assertion. Run before adding the prewarming-only observability counter; final all-target Clippy includes the updated code.
validation.guards: Mismatched transaction, block environment and configuration fall back. Expiring-nonce omitted/reordered candidates compare full outcomes and actual block access lists; paid fee rebasing is exercised.

limitations: No node performance improvement claimed until the GitHub comparison finishes.
Parent-state prewarming can replay frequently for repeated payer balances or omitted nonce predecessors; forwarding the committed prefix is a potential next optimization.
Historical active-worker mainnet coverage from the preceding integration remains sparse. This change targets building and does not replace broad differential/replay acceptance.
